{{Quote|Are you sure your ship is intact? This sector has frequent meteor activity!''"<br />"''It's in orbit, protected by a magnetogravitic shield!|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Reynar]]|<ref name="Deadly Allies" />}}
A '''magnetogravitic shield''', also known as a '''magnetogravic shield''', was a basic [[Starship/Legends|starship]] protection system that kept a ship from burning while traveling at near [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]]. The system's function was to deflect minute particles away from the ship's [[Hull/Legends|hull]]. It could also operate inside the ship instead of outside in order to secure its cargo.

==History==
{{Quote|I simply altered the controls of your magnetogravic shield to operate inside the ship instead of outside&mdash;the setting used to secure cargo!|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Deadly Allies" />}}
During the [[Battle of Antolus I|battle]] of [[Antolus I]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] used the [[Maxillipede shuttle/Legends|Maxillipede shuttle]] [[Conqueror (Maxillipede shuttle)|''Conqueror'']], which was equipped with a magnetogravitic shield. This protection system kept the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] safe from the frequent meteor activity around Antolus I. While trying to escape the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] altered the magnetogravitic shield of the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] in order to immobilize several [[Iron/Legends|iron]]-covered [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] inside the ship.
